baseline: After the existing core, SOAP, published, and mysql-http-fpm patch stages (or the complete legacy series).

patches.adaptation: Restore the temporarily overwritten filename separator as in the published native PHP 7.1 backport; retain char* ownership and existing TSRMLS APIs. The new compatibility test uses the published GH-21986 tar builder with ordinary nested links.

verification_limits.gd: The published CVE-2026-9672 commit contains no regression fixture. Existing gif.phpt is an ordinary compatibility control, not an exploit reproduction.
verification_limits.openssl: Run the unchanged upstream gh22186.phpt only where its actual cipher probe succeeds; an unsupported-cipher skip is not a passing regression.
verification_limits.phar: The three circular-symlink tar fixtures and their PHPT are byte-identical to upstream. The additional ordinary-link control checks the published path-separator adaptation.
